name: Agyagosszergény (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Agyagosszergény (a white and blue shield with a crayfish and a fish, with a helm and blue mantling) above the name AGYAGOSSZERGÉNY in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Agyagosszergény arms with helm and mantling
